# cdn-apple.com
> Apple-hosted content delivery domain serving software updates, support assets, developer resources, and product media.

This domain is primarily a CDN endpoint used by Apple to distribute static files rather than a conventional navigable website. The most useful context for LLMs comes from Apple’s canonical documentation, support, developer, and service-status properties that describe the content commonly delivered through Apple infrastructure.

## Apple Developer Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/): Central index for Apple platform frameworks, APIs, and technologies.
- [Xcode](https://developer.apple.com/xcode/): Official Xcode IDE overview, downloads, and release information.
- [Swift](https://developer.apple.com/swift/): Swift language resources, tooling, and ecosystem information.
- [Design](https://developer.apple.com/design/): Human Interface Guidelines and platform design resources.
- [Downloads](https://developer.apple.com/download/): Developer downloads for tools, betas, and additional resources.
- [Support](https://developer.apple.com/support/): Developer support programs, technical help, and account assistance.

## Platform Documentation
- [iOS & iPadOS](https://developer.apple.com/ios/): Platform overview, SDK resources, and development guidance.
- [macOS](https://developer.apple.com/macos/): macOS development resources, frameworks, and tooling.
- [watchOS](https://developer.apple.com/watchos/): watchOS app development guidance and platform capabilities.
- [tvOS](https://developer.apple.com/tvos/): tvOS development documentation and app platform resources.
- [visionOS](https://developer.apple.com/visionos/): visionOS platform guidance, SDK information, and design resources.
- [Safari & Web](https://developer.apple.com/safari/): Safari, WebKit, and web development resources for Apple platforms.

## API Reference and Frameworks
- [App Store Connect API](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/appstoreconnectapi/): REST API for managing App Store Connect resources and workflows.
- [StoreKit](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/storekit/): In-app purchase APIs, subscriptions, and App Store commerce features.
- [SwiftUI](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/swiftui/): Declarative UI framework documentation for Apple platforms.
- [UIKit](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/uikit/): iOS interface framework for building app user experiences.
- [Foundation](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/foundation/): Core data types, collections, localization, and system services.
- [URL Loading System](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/foundation/url_loading_system): Networking APIs for loading URLs and handling transfers.
- [Device Management](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/devicemanagement/): MDM protocol and Apple device management API documentation.

## Apple Platform Security and Deployment
- [Apple Platform Security](https://support.apple.com/guide/security/welcome/web): Official security architecture and feature documentation.
- [Deployment Guide](https://support.apple.com/guide/deployment/welcome/web): Enterprise and education deployment guidance for Apple devices.
- [Platform Deployment](https://support.apple.com/deployment): Deployment resources, planning, and management documentation.
- [Business Essentials User Guide](https://support.apple.com/guide/apple-business-essentials/welcome/web): Administration and user guidance for Apple Business Essentials.
- [Apple Configurator User Guide](https://support.apple.com/guide/apple-configurator-mac/welcome/mac): Device provisioning and configuration instructions for administrators.

## Software Updates and Restore Resources
- [Apple Support Downloads](https://support.apple.com/downloads): Official software downloads, firmware, and support tools.
- [Update Apple software](https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/update-macos-on-mac-mchlpx1065/mac): Guidance for updating macOS on supported devices.
- [Update your iPhone or iPad](https://support.apple.com/en-us/118575): Instructions for installing iOS and iPadOS updates.
- [Revive or restore a Mac with Apple silicon](https://support.apple.com/en-us/108900): Recovery procedures using Apple Configurator for supported Macs.
- [Restore iPhone, iPad, or iPod to factory settings](https://support.apple.com/guide/itunes/restore-to-factory-settings-itnsdb1fe305/windows): Device restore workflow using Apple Devices or iTunes.

## Support and User Guides
- [Apple Support](https://support.apple.com/): Main support portal for products, services, and troubleshooting.
- [iPhone User Guide](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/welcome/ios): Official iPhone usage and feature documentation.
- [iPad User Guide](https://support.apple.com/guide/ipad/welcome/ipados): Official iPad usage and feature documentation.
- [Mac User Guide](https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/welcome/mac): Official macOS help and system feature documentation.
- [Apple Watch User Guide](https://support.apple.com/guide/watch/welcome/watchos): Official Apple Watch setup and usage documentation.
- [AirPods User Guide](https://support.apple.com/guide/airpods/welcome/web): Official AirPods setup, controls, and troubleshooting documentation.

## Services and System Status
- [System Status](https://www.apple.com/support/systemstatus/): Real-time availability information for Apple services and infrastructure.
- [Apple ID Support](https://support.apple.com/apple-id): Help for account access, security, and identity management.
- [iCloud Support](https://support.apple.com/icloud): Support resources for iCloud apps, storage, and synchronization.
- [Apple Music Support](https://support.apple.com/apple-music): Help for Apple Music subscriptions, playback, and library management.
- [App Store Support](https://support.apple.com/app-store): Support for purchases, downloads, and App Store issues.

## News and Release Information
- [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/): Official press releases, announcements, and company news.
- [Developer News](https://developer.apple.com/news/): Updates for developers about APIs, tools, and platform changes.
- [Release Notes](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/xcode-release-notes): Xcode and SDK release notes for developers.
- [Security Releases](https://support.apple.com/en-us/100100): Apple security update and patch release information.
- [HT201222: Apple security updates](https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT201222): Historical index of Apple security advisories and updates.

## Apple Business and Education
- [Apple Business Manager](https://business.apple.com/): Device enrollment, app distribution, and organization management portal.
- [Apple School Manager](https://school.apple.com/): Education deployment portal for devices, apps, and managed accounts.
- [Apple at Work](https://www.apple.com/business/): Business-focused deployment, security, and productivity resources.
- [Education](https://www.apple.com/education/): Education solutions, deployment information, and institutional resources.
- [IT Resources](https://www.apple.com/business/docs/site/): Technical deployment and IT documentation for business environments.
